environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet behind internal ALB (scheme: internal). Lambda function URL configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM and resource-based policy restricting lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to principal arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:root with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching organization. VPC endpoint policy for execute-api restricts invocation to VPC-originating requests. The container's awsvpc ENI has no public IP and the subnet route table has no IGW route - only NAT gateway for outbound. Security group on internal ALB allows inbound only from the Lambda function's VPC-attached ENI security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) on port 8080. AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint for Lambda is configured with a security group allowing only the Lambda execution role's VPC ENI.

config.network: private subnet, internal ALB scheme, no IGW route in subnet RT
config.alb_security_group: inbound rule: sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f (Lambda ENI SG) port 8080 only
config.key_storage: SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY from Secrets Manager with rotation every 24h via Lambda rotator
